features.statement: A single saturated cyan accent color is used for CTAs, links, badges and one highlighted headline line.
Dark page uses layered, slightly lighter dark surface tones for header, cards and footer bands.
Secondary text such as labels, counts and footer links uses a muted gray-blue.
Only one font family, the system UI stack, is used across the whole page.
Large bold H1 split over two lines, with the second line colored in the accent.
Section H2 headings are small (about 20px) and bold, much smaller than the hero H1, and left-aligned.
Card titles are truncated with ellipses within the text content itself.
Header is a slim top bar with logo left and a few text links plus a pill button right.
Content sits in a centered fixed-width container with generous side margins on wide viewports.
Hero shows headline, short muted description and a stats row, with pill CTA right and empty space beside.
Content sections repeat a three-column card grid with consistent column positions and small gutters.
Cards use very tall images that dominate the page height.
Imagery consists of user-submitted photos rather than polished illustrations or stock art.
Letter-initial circle avatars stand in for user photos, occasionally mixed with photo avatars.
Section headings carry a right-aligned text 'View All' link in the accent color.
Community cards show a small rounded-corner square logo tile, bold name and member count.
Auth options are text-only buttons without provider icons, stacked horizontally in a bordered rounded panel with centered heading.
All interactive controls are anchor elements; no button elements are used.
Decoration is minimal: no gradients, blur, animations or transforms, with few transitions.
Footer includes corporate address, platform credit and a non-affiliation disclaimer.
Heading hierarchy is clean: one H1, H2 per section, H3 for card titles.
Layout built mainly with flexbox plus some CSS grid, styled by one embedded style block with few semantic classes.
Copy is brief and promotional with occasional exclamation marks and no emoji.
Page title combines the H1 text and site name, joined by an en dash.
Content images have empty alt attributes.
